Like many GP clinics, St Wulfstan’s Surgery in Warwickshire faced rising documentation pressures impacting both patient experience and clinician wellbeing. Between February and May 2025, the practice piloted Tandem’s ambient AI scribe - the impact was immediate. Clinicians reported faster documentation, reduced stress, and more time to engage meaningfully with patients.
Patient presence and clarity improved by 10%
Patients reported greater GP presence (89.9% vs. 83.6%) and better understanding of care plans.
GPs said Tandem helped them remember key details and improved satisfaction: “100% of GPs felt it was an improvement over their previous way of working.”
“Very impressed by the AI summary accuracy.”

GPs reported stress falling from 49.3% to 30.4% when Tandem was used. They also said they felt more satisfied, less drained, and more present with patients. 100% agreed that Tandem helped them remember key details and improved their overall workflow
“In 100% of cases, GPs felt the AI-scribe helped them remember key aspects of the consultation and represented an improvement over the previous way of working.”

St Wulfstan’s Surgery made governance central to the pilot: DPIA, DCB0160, updated privacy policies, and new EMIS protocols. Once implemented, Tandem passed every safety and quality audit — all notes were rated “clinically appropriate.” Patients also accepted the tool, with none reporting disruption.
“Tandem has improved the accuracy of notes — capturing useful information I wouldn’t have recorded due to time constraints. It makes clinic a lot more efficient and less stressful.”
“Patients feel that both they and the GP are more present during the consultation… this could improve communication and reduce complaints.”

Digital mental health provider

Mindler integrated Tandem directly into its platform. Psychologists start Tandem at the beginning of a session, and the tool creates a draft note in real time. After a quick review, the note is transferred into the system. This allows psychologists to stay more present in the conversation while still finishing their workday on time.

“I expected AI to save time, but I didn’t realize how much it would also improve the quality of my sessions. Being able to focus fully on the patient, without thinking about notes, makes the work feel more meaningful and less stressful.”
Proven results: hours saved and a better workday

Tandem quickly proved its value in the organisation. After the pilot, adoption spread across Mindler’s network of more than 200 psychologists in multiple countries. The combination of speed, trust, and clinical relevance made Tandem a natural part of daily work.

“We are always looking for innovations that create real value for both patients and psychologists. Introducing Tandem’s AI documentation support is part of our strategy to combine clinical expertise with smart technology. It helps us improve quality, reduce friction in daily work, and enable our teams to deliver care at scale.”
